image.prompt:
A single manga panel.

The character in this panel is shown in the attached reference sheet.
Keep his face, hairstyle, eyes, outfit, scar and scarf EXACTLY as the
reference sheet shows. Do not restyle, age, or redesign him.
Only his pose, expression and surroundings change.

His fixed appearance, for reference:
Kaito Ren, an 18-year-old male rooftop courier. Short messy black hair with a blunt fringe falling over the left eyebrow. Sharp amber eyes, thin angular face, light olive skin. Wears a dark grey high-collared courier jacket over a white shirt, cargo trousers and worn lace-up boots. Distinguishing marks: a long pale scar through the right eyebrow, and a frayed deep-red scarf always wound twice around his neck, one end hanging to his waist.

Framing: Square panel. Frame the character from the waist up, centred, with headroom above and nothing important near the edges.
Camera: Medium shot, eye level, facing the camera.
Action: He is tugging the scarf tighter with both hands, a small tired smile, eyes on something just past the camera.
Background: A rooftop at night, water towers and tangled cables behind him, the city lights soft and out of focus.

Black and white manga artwork, screentone shading, confident inked linework. Seinen style, detailed backgrounds, strong use of blacks. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no speech bubbles, no sound effects, no signatures, no watermarks and no panel borders anywhere in the image.
